_note: Starting points for 'add a connection of your own' (D-245) — NOT connections.
Choosing one fills the add form; nothing exists until the user's own probe
reaches the server and it answers with its tools. That is the whole point:
we ship the shape, the server supplies the truth.
Every entry's shape was read from a PRIMARY source on 2026-08-24 — the
vendor's own repository or docs, named in `source` — never from a search
summary or another list. The list is short for that reason.
Deliberately absent: servers that authenticate only by OAuth 2.1. Our
transports carry a static credential (D-243), so an OAuth-only server would
be a suggestion that cannot work — worse than no suggestion at all.
No entry names `tools`. Tools come from the server, never from a file.
